verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows documentation pages that describe model comparisons and pricing (gpt-supp-models-compare, gpt-docs-26) but never mentions a documented API endpoint (e.g., GET /v1/models) for programmatically enumerating the live model catalog, nor any SDK/CLI example calling such an endpoint. The OpenAPI probe (gpt-probe-3) even failed to find a machine-readable spec that would confirm such an endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a models-list API endpoint, an SDK/CLI code example enumerating models, and confirmation via OpenAPI spec or reference docs.
